categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates container terminals and inland container freight stations, offering services such as ship cargo handling, container yard operations, and warehousing. It also engages in related logistics, cargo packing, machinery installation and maintenance, international trade, software services, and real estate leasing and development related to port facilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced port machinery including new gantry cranes with auxiliary positioning systems, electric-powered equipment to replace diesel machinery, and smart energy management systems with digital meters and energy storage to optimize power usage. It also develops and upgrades container terminal operating systems (TOS) and integrates container information systems (BONIGO) to enhance operational efficiency and customer service.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major shipping lines such as Yang Ming Marine Transport, Taiwan Ocean Shipping, and other international shipping companies. The company serves the maritime shipping and logistics industries, focusing on containerized cargo handling and inland container distribution within Taiwan's major ports.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, specifically at container terminals in Keelung Port, Taichung Port, and inland container freight stations in Wudu. The company aims to develop a comprehensive service network covering northern, central, and southern international ports in Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the maritime logistics supply chain, providing container handling, storage, and related terminal services that connect upstream shipping lines with downstream logistics and inland distribution providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding business scope from port terminals to inland freight stations, enhancing upstream and downstream collaboration with shipping and logistics partners, and developing a vertically integrated port supply chain. R&D focuses on upgrading port operating systems, implementing energy-saving and carbon reduction technologies, and adopting digital tools like LINE BOT for real-time container tracking to improve customer service.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service fees for container handling, ship cargo operations, container yard management, and warehousing services. Additional income comes from leasing port-related real estate and providing logistics and machinery maintenance services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Lien Hsing International Transport and Taiwan International Ports Corporation at Keelung Port, and Evergreen Marine and Wan Hai Lines at Taichung Port. The company holds a significant market share in Keelung (43.7%) and Taichung (34.8%) ports, leveraging its non-shipping line background to attract diverse customers and maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.29 billion, a 4.46% increase from the previous year, with operating profit rising 26.77% to NT$341 million and net profit after tax increasing 14.85% to NT$116 million. The company maintains stable financial health with total assets around NT$9.8 billion and equity of NT$3.27 billion, showing steady growth and investment in capital expenditures totaling about NT$940 million for equipment upgrades and energy management systems.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, integrated container terminal and inland freight services with advanced technology adoption to improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. Its non-affiliation with shipping lines reduces conflicts of interest, enabling it to offer more diversified and customized supply chain solutions. Commitment to sustainability through energy-efficient equipment and carbon footprint management further differentiates its service offering.
